en-US: Use the new CodeMirror-powered Markdown source editor with theme-aware syntax styling, lazy loading, and Tab/Shift-Tab indentation.
Improve content readability across Web, Android, and iOS with refined spacing, table layout, dark-mode selection contrast, and inline-code styling.
Keep the public Demo workspace consistent after scheduled resets instead of retaining stale local data.
Publish Tencent TCR multi-architecture images through Tencent-side builds for faster and more reliable availability in China.

优化 Web、Android 和 iOS 的内容可读性，包括间距、表格布局、深色模式选区对比度和行内代码样式。
修复公开 Demo 定时重置后仍可能保留旧本地数据的问题，确保工作区状态一致。
